sameProductExplanation.classification: 4399 OL partner player guide, not an exclusive official FAQ
supportedObservations: Choujue accepts either direction of HP/hand difference; examples explicitly include hand0/hp3 and hand4/hp1.
Qingjiao equipment subtype condition prevents two weapons; it does not collapse all non-equipment into a single subtype slot.
Normal Slash, FireSlash and ThunderSlash are distinct names for this Qingjiao pool, despite all belonging to the Slash family in use-count queries.
Ending all-card discard includes equipment; upgraded Lvli still has only1 activation per foreign actual turn.

evidenceHierarchy: Current public OL character/cha_spell rows and matching official hero/API establish the ordinary OL identity, male, Wei, 5 maximum HP, and complete four-skill chain3150/3151/3152/3153. The linked skills are registered as real leaf skills, not initial general skills.
The official2022-12-23 OL release announces actual acquisition from2022-12-24 and prints the complete chain. It distinguishes this identity from other products or earlier Wen Yang rules.

The4399 yxsgs49378 partner guide is a same-product explanation, not an exclusive official FAQ. It supports absolute HP/hand difference, either no-effect Lvli choice, own2/foreign1 after Choujue, shared caused/received limit after Beishui, equipment-slot uniqueness, distinct normal/fire/thunder Slash names and Ending equipment discard.

lvli: Actual native AfterDamageApplied instances qualify; a two-point damage is one opportunity. Prevention or HP loss alone never qualifies. Before Beishui only caused damage qualifies; after Beishui genuine received damage including source-less damage also qualifies.

Lvli has one shared actual-turn allowance, increased to two only during its owner actual turn after the genuine Choujue awakening. Caused and received damage share this allowance. Self damage has one opportunity, not a duplicate caused/received pair. Source loss/regrant cannot reset the actual-turn scalar usage history.

Both choices remain available with zero benefit, including equality and choosing recovery with hand below HP. The accepted numeric difference is frozen before native draw/recovery. Recovery still uses native maximum-HP caps, modifiers, replacement, HP observers and rescue; draw still uses native DrawCards with shortage and movement children.

Deduplication binds the exact native DamageTriggerWindow ID and its corresponding actual DamageFrame. Each AOE recipient has a separate native DamageFrame/window, even though the group card Use is shared. The focused check follows these native invoices rather than assuming that DamageFrameId is the shared UseId.
awakenings: Choujue checks absolute hand-minus-HP distance at each actual TurnEnded, including another character turn. It is not an Ending-stage substitute. The once-awakened result is persistent owner history; loss/regrant of a source does not undo the actual previous awakening.

Beishui checks only a genuine Preparation entry, with hand<2 or HP<2. A flipped whole-turn skip does not synthesize Preparation. Its received-damage upgrade does not create a second independent Lvli allowance.

Each awakening pays exactly one maximum HP and grants the real linked Beishui/Qingjiao leaf through native AcquireRuntimeSkills/SkillsAcquired/SkillsChanged. Ownership revisions are primed with TryAdd before the first possible native grant. The new operation can pay1to0 and enter direct native death; it does not change the shared historical maximum-HP clamp.
qingjiao: At actual Play start, choosing Qingjiao atomically discards the complete legally payable original hand. Existing self-hand discard restrictions are respected; a hand containing an unpayable card cannot satisfy the complete-hand cost.

After native payment children, up to8 actual entities are chosen from the existing combined draw/discard inventory. Newly discarded original hand entities are eligible. Selection rejects duplicate exact CardKind names and duplicate equipment EquipmentSlot values; ordinary non-equipment names remain independent. The deterministic engine RNG is replayed through commands. No replacement draw or artificial reshuffle is used.

The gain is real movement from each exact original pile to the owner hand. The actual gain attempt issues one scalar actual-turn Ending debt. At that genuine Ending, the owner discards all currently legal HE, retaining native forbidden-card, GeneralWeapon OutsideGame, SilverLion recovery and WoodenOx grain behavior.

The issued debt is injected from its immutable source/hash/debt facts even when the original Qingjiao source is gone; it is bound to the exact native TurnEnding item/current cursor. Its owning ProgramSkillFrame stores paid entities and native child return. No parallel global pending object or use-ID sidecar is introduced.

implementationInferences: No dedicated same-product FAQ for empty-hand Qingjiao was located. The unrestricted all-hand wording is implemented as allowing an empty complete-hand cost.

No dedicated same-product FAQ for a hand containing a forbidden-to-discard card was located. The cost is all hand cards, so the activation requires the full hand to be legally payable; it cannot silently pay only an arbitrary subset.

No dedicated same-product FAQ for fewer than8 distinct eligible cards or no eligible supply was located. The existing physical inventory is exhausted as far as possible; a zero-card obtain attempt still reaches the textual if-so Ending obligation after the real discard attempt.

The exact tie distribution/order among otherwise valid inventory entities is not specified by the text. The implementation repeatedly chooses uniformly from currently legal entities with the seeded engine RNG, preserving replay and both name/slot exclusions.

If genuine paid discard children kill the recipient before obtaining, native death finishes and no later cards/debt are created. If the source alone is lost after payment, the already-paid obtain and issued Ending continue. This is once-paid native continuation, not permission to start an unpaid skill without its source.
The special Ending cost discards the currently legally discardable HE rather than bypassing general card protections. Native secondary grain spill is excluded from the primary logical-discard count.
runtimeBoundaries: ProgramSkillFrame.WenYang is nullable and omitted when absent. Nested entity/grain lists use defensive Array.AsReadOnly copies. New rule facts contain scalar values and immutable scalar records; no collection-bearing new committed-event projection is required.

All new progression uses AdvanceEventRulesAndQueueFact and AdvanceRulesAndPublishState. Native damage/dying, recovery, movement, ownership and original phase/end parent contracts remain exact. An accepted child return never repeats the completed payment.
No rules/schema/package version change, per-character definition snapshot, new runner switch, or default verification-scope expansion was made.
